text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're facing Special Week
head-on. The
day of the spring Tenno
Sho has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do it. Just watch and you'll
see.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've put myself through hell.
But if it all
pays off...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, you're on fire! But don't go think'n
you've
won it just yet!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I had some huge helpings of carrots,
p'tatoes and
raw whitebait, so I've got a
whole lot of energy to
run on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe and Special Week are
talking
past each other. That said...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. The more she riles herself
up, the
higher a toll her body pays...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But how will her toenails and sesamoid
bones hold up? We've managed so far
with your dedicated
care and my
scientific treatments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, I think she'll get through today just fine. Beyond that, who can say. The real issue will be...
choice_data_list: Does this race look tough to you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her motivation. Her core's not a problem

anymore, but there's a new poison in the
mix...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Plan B. We may have gone too far down
a narrow
path...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Manhattan Cafe, I feel
unsettled by the
intensity of her
expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I thought she'd forgive me, I'd say it.
...I'd tell
her to stop chasing after her
friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that's the one thing I can't say.
It was our first
promise—the one we made on
the day we entered
our contract.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For now, I can only pray she comes back

uninjured.
